citation.title: Maybank Manchester United Platinum Visa Card

extra.summary: The Maybank Manchester United Visa Platinum Card is tailored for fans of Manchester United, offering exclusive rewards and privileges related to the football club. Cardholders can enjoy discounts on merchandise, match tickets, and access to special events, along with earning up to 3% Cashback when Manchester United wins.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Interest Rate: 27.90% p.a. subject to a minimum charge of S$3.00
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Fee Waiver: Available with a minimum of S$3,600 spent
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: 3% of outstanding balance or S$20, whichever is higher

minimum-income-requirements.Non-Singaporean Minimum Annual Income: S$60000. Malaysia Citizens (in employment for at least 1 year): S$45,000

our_takes.our-take: If you're a die-hard Man U fan, this card boosts cashback to 3% and TREATS points 5x on match days when they win (capped at $20 extra cashback per win). Otherwise, it’s a basic 1% cashback card with 1x TREATS points, suitable if you want a simple card and don't mind limited perks. Note the $3,600 annual spend to waive the S$87.20 fee. High 27.9% interest and 2.25% foreign transaction fee are standard, so clear your balance and avoid using it overseas.
our_takes.good-for:
Manchester United fans wanting to earn extra cashback on match days when the team wins.
Cardholders looking to easily waive annual fees by meeting a reasonable minimum spending requirement of S$3,600 per year.
Individuals who appreciate contactless payment options and mobile wallet compatibility for convenient everyday transactions and rewards.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Late payment fees are high; expect 5% or S$100 (whichever is higher) if you miss the minimum payment.
A 27.90% p.a. interest rate applies if you don't pay in full, significantly increasing debt over time.
Foreign currency transactions incur a 3.25% fee, impacting your spending while traveling overseas.
